meta.method: walk-forward facts; strength offset; series bootstrap 95% CI

R19.label: Supported
R19.test: Games where one team took first Dragon and the other took the Grubs majority: does the Dragon team win more than team strength predicts?

R11.label: Unclear
R11.test: Do early comps with bot/mid priority gain MORE from first Dragon + Grubs majority than other comps? (interaction: rule fires x share of the two objectives taken)

R12.label: Unclear
R12.test: Do late comps facing early comps lose LESS from conceding first Dragon + Grubs majority than other comps? (interaction: rule fires x share of the two objectives taken)

R15.label: Supported
R15.test: Premise: a facilitator jungler facing a carry jungler is behind in jungle gold at 15 (the plan itself, ganking instead of farming, is not visible in the data).

R17.label: Supported
R17.test: Drafts with no Strong lane and at least one Weak lane (forecast): do they win less than team strength predicts?

R24.label: Supported
R24.test: Top lanes forecast Weak: are they behind in top gold at 15 (beyond team strength)?

R25.label: Unclear
R25.test: Early comps with mid and bot priority: more tower plates than strength and the team gold forecast predict?

R29.label: Unclear
R29.test: Lane gold at 15: is blind-picking a matchup-dependent champion worse than blind-picking others (interaction blind x matchup-dependent)?

R30.label: Supported
R30.test: Mid-jungle duos forecast Weak: behind in mid + jungle gold at 15 (beyond team strength)?

R40.label: Unclear
R40.test: Against an enemy star laner: does our laner do better at 15 when we counterpicked the star (star picked first) than when the star counterpicked us? (Jungle pressure is not visible.)
